title: TextLink
description: A styled native anchor for inline links, quiet navigation and settings rows; asChild styles a router link without nesting anchors.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: default is underlined, subtle adds a chevron as a non-color cue, action is a full-width row.

as-child.title: Router links
as-child.description: asChild merges the styling onto its single child element.

TextLinkProps.asChild: Merges the link styling onto its single child element
TextLinkProps.variant: Visual style: default, subtle or action

cssVars.--text-link-color: Color of the default variant (falls back to --link-color, then --primary-color)
cssVars.--text-link-text-decoration: Text decoration of the default variant (default: underline)
cssVars.--text-link-underline-offset: Distance between the text and its underline
cssVars.--text-link-action-min-height: Minimum height of the action variant
